title: Why More Context Makes Your Agent Dumber and What to Do About It — Nupur Sharma, Qodo
summary: Give an agent your full codebase and it will attend to the start and the end, then quietly drop the middle. Nupur from Qodo calls this the U curve and builds the whole talk around it: why growing the context window did not fix the problem, and what actually does. She runs through iterative retrieval, hierarchical summarization, and self correction …
why: Directly addresses the U-curve attention problem — specific engineering patterns (iterative retrieval, hierarchical summarization) for keeping long-context agents reliable, the kind of thing worth sharing with a new AI team.

title: Why Eval++ Is the Next Great Compute Primitive — Sunil Pai & Matt Carrie, Cloudflare
summary: Matt Carrie and Sunil Pai from Cloudflare's agents team explain why Durable Objects turned out to be the right compute unit for AI agents: addressable, persistent, hibernating, stateful, and fast enough that 15ms London latency puts you inside a single animation frame. The Agents SDK builds on this to give resumable streaming, multi tab sync, and background scheduling out of …
why: Cloudflare's case study on how stateful, addressable compute (Durable Objects) becomes the right primitive for resumable agent workflows — useful reference architecture when designing agent infrastructure at Bloomberg.
